title: Best AI Website Builder for Ecommerce in 2026
summary: Most 'AI store builders' don't build a store, they pick a template or write you a front end. We scored eight tools on whether they actually generate products, checkout, and tax, not just a storefront that looks like one.
body_markdown: Not a complete one on their own. Lovable and Bolt both generate a storefront-looking app with no products, stock, tax, or checkout logic behind it, a front end waiting for a real commerce backend. Lovable can connect to Shopify to solve this; Bolt requires wiring Stripe and an admin panel by hand.
